title: Freaking Out the Neighborhood
lyrics:
[00:27.77]Sorry, mama
[00:35.02]There are times I get carried away
[00:41.11]Please, don't worry
[00:48.32]Next time I'm home, I'll still be the same
[00:55.54]And I know, it's no fun
[01:02.24]When your first son
[01:09.01]Gets up to no good
[01:16.76]Starts freakin' out the neighborhood
[01:22.95]Really, I'm fine
[01:30.16]Never been better, got no job on the line
[01:35.95]Sincerely, don't worry
[01:43.52]Same ol' boy that you hoped you would find
[01:51.14]And I know, it's no fun
[01:57.45]When your first son
[02:04.13]Gets up to no good
[02:11.93]Starts freakin' out the neighborhood
